Keep your PurpleTV settings the same on all your devices, through one small file in your Google Drive (or any cloud storage your device offers). No sign-in needed.

On your first device, tap "Create sync file" and save it in Google Drive. On your other devices, tap "Use existing file" and pick that same file.

After that, each device saves its settings to the file when you change them, and loads them when Twitch opens.
